subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The scarf returned with a small lesson: not every lost thing is stolen.”?
options: It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.
Some things are simply waiting for the right person to bring them back.
A public thank-you may reach the right person in the end.
Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The scarf returned with a small lesson: not every lost thing is stolen. Some things are simply waiting for the right person…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A public thank-you may reach the right person in the end.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The scarf returned with a small lesson: not every lost thing is stolen. Some things are simply waiting for the right person to bring…」，答案為「Some things are simply waiting for the right person to bring them back.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some things are simply waiting for the right person to bring them back.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
